## Done so far

1. **Flywheel CLI** installed at `~/.local/bin/flywheel` (PATH updated in `.zshrc` / `.zprofile`)
2. **Previous CLI-mode install** reconciled to MCP mode (`--force`)
3. **Bundled skills** installed for Cursor at `~/.agents/skills/` (`flywheel`, `flywheel-auto`, `flywheel-prove`, etc.)

## Action required — complete auth

Setup is waiting for you to approve device auth. I opened this in your browser:

**URL:** https://flywheel.paradigma.inc/auth/mcp/setup/device?user_code=Q2RM-6ZPS  
**Code:** `Q2RM-6ZPS`

Approve the connection in the browser. Once you do, the installer will finish and write the Flywheel MCP server to `~/.cursor/mcp.json` pointing at `https://flywheel.paradigma.inc/mcp-server`.

If the code expired, re-run:

```bash
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
flywheel setup --mode mcp --install-skill
```

## After auth completes

Per the [Flywheel MCP setup docs](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/mcp/setup):

```bash
flywheel auth:status
flywheel help
```

Then **restart Cursor** (or reload MCP servers) and confirm Flywheel tools appear (graph, artifact, hook, compute operations).

Reply once you've approved in the browser and I can verify the MCP config and auth status.
